name: smb-ops-pipeline
description: Ten boring, stable pipeline tools over one Google Sheet (Contacts / Interactions / Config). stdio MCP.

PIPELINE_SPREADSHEET_ID.title: Pipeline Spreadsheet Id
PIPELINE_SPREADSHEET_ID.description: Google Sheet id created during getting-started (pipeline_init_sheet or Drive fallback). Not a secret.

PIPELINE_BACKEND.title: Pipeline Backend
PIPELINE_BACKEND.description: file (default, local JSON) or sheets (Google Sheets API adapter; stub in v0.1).

GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Google Oauth Refresh Token
GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: SECRET placeholder for the sheets backend. Set only in Configure/env. Never commit.
